test_bench_baseline.py.reason: Tests the phase 0 measurement harness (bench_baseline.py), which measures any supervisor through the run control socket. Not ported; it measures the Rust run too.

drop.test_a_key_press_imports_no_json_re_or_s: Python import time of the key helper. The Rust helper is one binary; key-press latency is measured by bench_baseline (kept) against the phase 0 baseline.

drop.test_watchdog_module_leaves_multiprocess: Python import cost of the multiprocessing module. A Rust binary has no imports; start-up time is measured by bench_baseline (kept).

drop.test_read_text_matches_path_read_text: Proves a Python speed-up (_read_text) equals pathlib.Path.read_text. Rust reads /proc with std::fs; there is no second implementation to compare. The behaviour (the session check) is ported with the rest of the class.
